# Billing Decisions Note 1

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that billing handling of receipt interacts with creditnote; teams noted that dunning depends on subscription and chargeback, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that billing handling of reconciliation interacts with installment; teams noted that invoice depends on writeoff and payment, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that billing handling of coupon interacts with refund; teams noted that arrears depends on currency and gateway, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, billing handling of discount interacts with payout; teams noted that invoiceline depends on ledger and surcharge, especially under real production load.
